subject: HelixHealth MAP: procurement milestones & marketplace billing route
messages:
From: Gina Roberts <gina.roberts@helixhealth.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Anders <tom.anders@helixhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: Initial MAP + billing path questions for HelixHealth purchase

Hi Vivek,

Thanks again for the demo earlier this week — the team was impressed with the latency profile on 16k context. Procurement wants to align on a mutual action plan (MAP) so we can evaluate and close via AWS Private Offer (we'll need marketplace billing). High-level asks from our side:

- An evaluation MAP with milestones (POC, security review, SOC2 evidence exchange, procurement approval).
- Confirmation that Redwood supports AWS Private Offers + marketplace billing flow (we have a finance constraint for marketplace invoicing).
- A realistic close timeline to get a PO in December if possible.

I've attached a short template that procurement prefers for MAPs. Can you confirm next steps and owners?

Attachments: Helix MAP template (see attached)

Gina Roberts
Senior Procurement Manager
HelixHealth

From: vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Gina Roberts <gina.roberts@helixhealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Initial MAP + billing path questions for HelixHealth purchase

Hi Gina —

Appreciate the clear list. We've drafted a tailored MAP and mapped each milestone to an owner at Redwood. High-level summary below; full MAP is attached (HelixHealth_MAP_v1.pdf).

Proposed MAP (owner):
- Week 1 (Nov 15–21): Kickoff + environment access & evaluation support (Vivek, Solutions)
- Week 2: Security evidence pack (SOC2 artefacts, data flow diagram) (Karthik, Security)
- Week 3: POC validation & performance tuning (Dev Eng team)
- Week 4: Procurement review of PO terms + AWS Private Offer creation (Marissa + Finance)
- Week 5: Signatures & Marketplace listing confirmation (Legal & AWS)

Marketplace/billing notes: Redwood supports AWS Private Offers and can enable marketplace invoicing to HelixHealth's billing entity. For AWS Private Offers we typically:
1) Agree commercial terms (list + discount) and issue SOW/PO language.
2) Create private offer in AWS marketplace (we coordinate with AWS sales).
3) Finalize billing route — marketplace invoice or direct vendor invoice can be chosen by you.

I've attached a blank AWS private-offer template we usually populate (HelixHealth_AWS_PrivateOffer_Template.docx). Marissa will lead the PO terms and coordinate DocuSign when we reach commercial agreement.

Next steps:
- If procurement is happy, sign off on the attached MAP v1 and we will schedule the kickoff for Nov 17.
- Please confirm preferred billing route (marketplace invoice or direct vendor invoice).

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: HelixHealth_MAP_v1.pdf (application/pdf)]
[Attachment: HelixHealth_AWS_PrivateOffer_Template.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)]

From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: HelixHealth MAP signoff + PO terms draft

Folks — quick internal note after Vivek's draft:

- Karthik: can you confirm the SOC2 pack ETA? Legal/procurement asked for encrypted logs and retention policy by EOD Monday. If we can't provide the specific artifact, give a mitigation note.
- Finance: I spoke with our AWS marketplace rep; they can create the private offer but need our commercial sheet by Nov 24. I've attached a short PO terms summary (PO_Terms_Summary.pdf).
- Once Karthik confirms security pack, I'll draft the commercial terms and route for Marissa+Finance approval. I can own DocuSign flow.

I'll copy the external thread once we have security confirmation.

Marissa Cole
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: PO_Terms_Summary.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Gina Roberts <gina.roberts@helixhealth.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Anders <tom.anders@helixhealth.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 16:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Initial MAP + billing path questions for HelixHealth purchase

Vivek / Marissa —

Thanks for the MAP and quick turnaround. Procurement reviewed the PDF and signed off on the milestones. We're happy to proceed with marketplace billing (Helix will accept AWS marketplace invoices). Two asks before kickoff:

1) Please populate the AWS Private Offer template with the proposed list price and discount; we need that to create the private offer record on our side.
2) Provide the SOC2 evidence summary or a secure link to the artifacts (we can accept a time-limited Drive share).

If you can get both items to us by Nov 24 we'll confirm kickoff for Nov 30 and aim to complete PO/DocuSign by Dec 14. That schedule meets our internal December close target.

I'll loop AWS Marketplace contact after you send the completed template.

Best,
Gina Roberts
Senior Procurement Manager
HelixHealth
